map.Macaulay 久期 = 各期现金流现值乘以其时间 t 之和除以债券价格；修正: Macaulay duration = the sum of each period's cash-flow present value multiplied by its time t, divided by the bond price; modified duration = Macaulay divided by (1 + per-period yield), expressing the price change for a 1% change in yield.
